name: The American College of Greece (Deree)
summary: Private American-style college in Athens where all classes are in English; majors in business, arts and sciences, and you can enter undecided.

ib.text: The IB Diploma proves English. Admission is by transcripts, a teacher recommendation and an interview; programme specifications give 24 IB points as the standard minimum. Merit awards cut tuition 10% to 35%.

noDeadline: Rolling; the college suggests applying by 15 June

apply.via: Deree online application for EU students (free to apply)

programmes.name: Biomedical Sciences
programmes.about: Four years of life sciences on top of the pre-med courses US medical schools ask for: biology, chemistry, physics and calculus, then anatomy, genetics, immunity and pharmacology, ending in a research thesis. Gives a US degree and a UK Open University degree.
programmes.ib: 24 IB points is the standard minimum in the programme specification; no IB subjects are named. Lower grades can mean provisional admission.
programmes.selectionNote: You apply to the college, not the major: transcripts, one teacher recommendation and an interview with an admissions counsellor; the IB Diploma counts as proof of English.

flagshipSource.title: Biomedical Sciences major: meets US pre-med requirements; US degree plus UK Open University degree

programmes.name: International Relations and European Affairs
programmes.about: Four years on how the international system works, from IR theory and foreign policy to European security, with research methods, ethics and an internship placed in an international organization.
programmes.ib: No IB subjects are named for the major. The college's standard minimum is 24 IB points; you also need a teacher recommendation and an interview.
programmes.selectionNote: You apply to the college, not the major: transcripts, one teacher recommendation and an interview with an admissions counsellor; the IB Diploma counts as proof of English.

flagshipSource.title: International Relations and European Affairs major: internship placement in an international organization

programmes.name: Music Performance
programmes.about: Four years of academic music study built around performance: research, evaluation and weekly performance labs, with European music at the centre. Open to applicants who pass an audition.
programmes.ib: No IB subjects are named. The college's standard minimum is 24 IB points, and you audition; the programme specification aligns the level with ABRSM Grade 6.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition first (contact the Music Department Head), then the college's transcripts, teacher recommendation and interview; the IB Diploma counts as proof of English.

flagshipSource.title: Music Performance major: music programme established in 1989, small classes, audition entry

faculties.name: School of Business and Economics
faculties.line: Majors from accounting, finance and economics to international business, marketing and shipping; the page lists no entry subjects.

faculties.name: Frances Rich School of Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences
faculties.line: Majors in music, theatre, cinema, design, humanities, communication and social sciences; the page lists no entry subjects.

faculties.name: School of Science and Technology
faculties.line: Majors in IT, cybersecurity, computer science, biomedical sciences, environmental studies and psychology; no entry subjects listed.

notes: All classes are in English, you can enter undecided and declare a major around your second year, and a double major is possible.
Tuition is charged per credit and is the same table for EU students and other countries: €400 a credit at 15 or more credits in 2026-27, plus a €54 matriculation fee.
Full-time students normally finish a US degree and an Open University validated award in four years; Greek recognition of the degree is a separate step for graduates.
